rooms.name: Pendulum room
rooms.short: You are strapped to a stone slab. A huge pendulum blade swings above you.
rooms.long: A dim cellar. You lie strapped to a stone slab in the middle, and a huge pendulum blade swings down from above. Barrels stand against the back wall on the left, and there are shackles on the right of the slab.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Claude Code by hand from the 10 Nov engine survey and a screenshot of the room
rooms.note: No exits while you are on the pendulum. Hotspots 101 and 50 both have the engine name HACKER: 50 is you (rect x 151 to 218, look line HOW DO I LOCK MYSELF THEN?) and 101 is a small spot by your hand (x 132 to 150, look line DAMN, I HAVE TO CUT MY NAILS!).

100.name: pendulum
100.description: A huge pendulum blade swinging above you. You'd prefer artichokes.

101.name: your hand
101.description: Your hand, strapped down. Looking at it, you say you have to cut your nails.
101.note: Inferred from the position by the hand and the nails line; the engine name HACKER is a leftover.

50.name: yourself
50.note: Inferred from the rect covering the hero and the look line.

102.name: shackles
102.description: Shackles on the right of the slab.
102.note: Engine name GRILLETES (Spanish); stock filler on look. The pack's text fixes already translate the word.

rooms.name: Cell with the torch
rooms.short: A cell with a torch on the wall and a door on the far left.
rooms.long: A cell. A torch hangs on the wall left of centre, and on the far left is a door, which the game calls obviously a secret door. It stays shut until you deal with the torch.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Claude Code by hand from the 10 Nov engine survey, updated 14 Nov from the engine state on entry (reached from the chapter 6 start save: take 101, use 20 100); positions from the engine's hotspot rectangles, no screenshot
rooms.note: Every playthrough passes through here once, after the pendulum (room 102). The first visit, at the chapter start, is a cutscene with no control. Moving the torch (push 103) sets flag 8 and turns 104 into a door to room 59; there is no way back from 59. Torch rect x 80 to 93, door rect x 32 to 72 (room 320 wide).

104.label: secret door to B.J.'s bedroom, opens after the torch

103.name: torch
103.note: Engine look line is stock filler (THERE IS NOTHING SPECIAL ABOUT IT). Puzzle object; description names it only.

rooms.name: B.J.'s bedroom
rooms.short: A bedroom where B.J. lies on a bed on the left. A wardrobe stands at the back and a trunk on the right.
rooms.long: A bedroom with a green rug. On the far left is a door, with a lamp on the wall beside it. B.J. lies on a bed on the left, under an oval mirror on the wall. At the back, right of centre, stands a tall wooden wardrobe. A window is on the right wall, with a wooden trunk below it.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Claude Code by hand from the 10 Nov engine survey and a screenshot of the room
rooms.note: The report lists the wardrobe (105, engine name CLOSET) as the way back to room 58, but the engine doesn't mark it as a door, and walking to it on 12 Nov didn't change room. Kept as an object of type exit for review.

108.label: door on the far left, to the bar

107.name: mirror
107.description: An oval mirror on the wall above the bed.
107.note: Stock filler on look. Description from the picture.

105.name: wardrobe
105.description: A tall wooden wardrobe at the back, right of centre.
105.note: Not a live exit: the engine forces this door off in room 59 (objects.cpp), so there is no way back to room 58.

106.name: trunk
106.description: A wooden trunk under the window on the right.
106.note: Stock filler on look. Description from the picture.

rooms.name: Bar
rooms.short: A crowded bar. Drascula stands in the middle, and a piano is on the right.
rooms.long: A bar with a wooden floor. On the left is an exit sign by some stairs, and a crowd of fans stands near it. The bartender is at the back in the middle, under a poster for burgers. Drascula, in his cape, stands in the middle of the room. On the right, behind a red curtain at the back, is a doorway, and another door is on the far right. A piano with a skull on it stands on the right. Barrels fill the foreground.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Claude Code by hand from the 10 Nov engine survey and a screenshot of the room
rooms.note: Hotspot 115 has the engine name FANS and covers the crowd on the left (x 57 to 150), not ceiling fans. Door 109 is at the back right of centre (x 200 to 238) and 110 on the far right (x 257 to 277); which one is behind the red curtain is inferred.

109.label: doorway at the back, to B.J.'s bedroom

110.label: door on the far right, to the back room

52.name: bartender
52.description: The bartender, at the back in the middle.
52.note: Stock filler on look. Description from the picture.

56.name: Drascula
56.description: Drascula, in his cape, in the middle of the bar.
56.note: Stock filler on look. Description from the picture.

112.name: piano
112.description: A piano on the right. The pianist is not here.

113.name: skull
113.description: A skull on top of the piano, with a very penetrating look.

114.name: poster
114.description: A poster: best burgers on this side of the Danube, only 325.

115.name: crowd of fans
115.description: A crowd of fans on the left of the bar.
115.note: Engine name FANS; stock filler on look.

rooms.name: Back room
rooms.short: A back room with a curtain, papers and a machine.
rooms.long: A small back room off the bar. The door back to the bar is on the far left. A curtain hangs left of centre, papers are pinned up right of centre, and a machine stands on the far right.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Claude Code by hand from the 10 Nov engine survey, updated 14 Nov from the engine state on entry (reached from the chapter 6 bar save with walk 110); positions from the engine's hotspot rectangles, no screenshot
rooms.note: Optional room: nothing in the game needs it. Rects (room 320 wide): door 111 x 35 to 70, curtain 117 x 97 to 142, papers 116 x 198 to 224, machine 118 x 244 to 290. 'Pinned up' for the papers is inferred from their height (y 53 to 80). open 117 says HEY, THE CURTAIN WILL NOT MOVE!; take 116 says WHY?.

116.name: papers
116.description: Papers. It's a bet for tonight's game.

117.name: curtain
117.description: A curtain. You wonder what's behind it.

118.name: machine
118.note: Stock filler on look. Nothing confirms what kind of machine.
